# Contributing

Use GitHub Issues to report problems or suggest improvements. Include the app
version, Windows version, steps to reproduce, expected result and actual result.
For display issues, state whether widescreen and fullscreen were enabled.
Screenshots are helpful; review them and logs for private information first.

Do not upload ROMs, original game assets, personal settings or snapshot files.
For gameplay problems, identify the character, port or sea area and the menu
or action involved. Widescreen is experimental; fixed indoor scenes retain
their original layout.

Follow README.md to build the source. Windows CI builds the complete application
and runs the existing ROM-free frontend, input, settings and audio checks.
It runs for main, pull requests and version tags. Gameplay requires your own
supported ROM and is not claimed by a successful ROM-free CI run.

Keep changes focused and preserve the original display option and third-party
notices. See SECURITY.md for private vulnerability reporting.
